bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
test "$(realpath "$root")" = /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot || exit 70
db="$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=postgres --format '{{.ID}}')"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$db" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 71
docker exec "$db" psql -U gace -d gaybbs -tA -F: -c "
SELECT count(*) AS rows,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE state='published') AS published,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE state='needs_reconcile') AS uncertain,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE pinned IS TRUE) AS pinned,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE message_id IS NOT NULL) AS has_id
FROM board_menu_panels WHERE chat_id IN (-1003847210571,-1002373696859,-1003770334893)
AND panel_type IN ('posting','general_guide');" || exit 72
echo LIVE_BOARD_PANEL_DB_READ_PASS
